name: project-list-01
title: Project List 01 - A List Of Projects, As Rows Or A Table
description: A list of projects with a toolbar, a filter column and a caller-written empty state, drawn either as scanned rows or as a real table with row and column headers. The two forms answer different questions and take the same field names as the project detail Block, so a consumer with a project model has one model. Server Component, and the toolbar is a slot so the client boundary stays the caller's.
